info.title: Sendmux Sending API
info.description: Send emails programmatically via the Sendmux email infrastructure. Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header; errors include a `retryable` flag. 429 and 503 responses include `Retry-After`. Mutating endpoints accept an `Idempotency-Key` header for safe retries.

OAuth2.description: Use the authorisation-code flow with S256 PKCE and resource=https://sendmux.ai/api. The user must grant Sending API access and email.send. OAuth access tokens authenticate HTTP requests; use a send-capable API key for SMTP.

scopes.email.send: Send email and manage temporary sending attachments

retryable.description: True when the client may safely retry the same request. 429 and 5xx default true; 4xx default false.

attachment_id.description: Temporary attachment ID to use in email attachments[].

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp when this temporary attachment reference expires.

upload_url.description: Short-lived URL that accepts a binary PUT with the returned headers.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp when the upload URL expires.

headers.description: Headers that must be sent with the PUT upload request.

filename.description: Filename to associate with the uploaded attachment.

content_type.description: MIME type expected for the upload.

size_bytes.description: Exact byte size that will be uploaded.

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 hex digest for the upload bytes.

message_id.description: Unique message identifier (eml_ prefix + 24 alphanumeric chars)

attachment_id.description: Temporary uploaded attachment ID returned by POST /emails/attachments.

cc.description: CC recipients (subject to 50 total To, CC, and BCC recipients)

bcc.description: BCC recipients (subject to 50 total To, CC, and BCC recipients)

custom_headers.description: Custom X-* headers to include in the email

delivery_group.description: One delivery group public ID or a non-empty array of up to 50 IDs

attachments.description: File attachments (max 10). Use attachment_id refs for uploaded files.

messages.description: Array of email messages to send (max 100)

get.description: Validate this Sending credential and return its team, connection label, permissions and authorised mailboxes. Requires email.send. Credits, provider readiness and mailbox storage are not checked. No user profile or secrets are returned.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Weak ETag from a previous response. When it matches the current resource, the server returns 304 Not Modified with no body.

304.description: Connection information is unchanged. Authentication is checked on every request.

403.description: Credential is not authorised for this API

post.description: Upload binary attachment bytes and receive a temporary attachment_id for use in attachments[]. Requires `email.send` permission.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key to make the request idempotent for 24 hours. Replays under the same key return the cached response; a reused key with a different body returns 409 idempotency_conflict.

parameters.name: Content-Length
parameters.description: Exact number of bytes in the binary request body.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Filename to associate with the uploaded attachment.

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: MIME type override for the uploaded attachment.

Location.description: Canonical URL for the temporary uploaded attachment metadata.

413.description: Attachment exceeds the upload size cap

get.description: Return metadata for a temporary uploaded attachment owned by the authenticated team. File bytes are not returned.

parameters.name: attachment_id
parameters.description: Temporary attachment ID returned by an upload endpoint.

post.description: Create a short-lived upload URL and token that lets a remote client PUT one binary attachment without exposing the API key on the upload request. Requires `email.send` permission.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key to make the request idempotent for 24 hours. Replays under the same key return the cached response; a reused key with a different body returns 409 idempotency_conflict.

Location.description: Canonical URL for the temporary attachment upload intent.

413.description: Attachment exceeds the upload size cap

put.summary: Upload bytes to an attachment upload URL
put.description: Upload the exact binary bytes for a previously-created attachment upload URL. This operation uses the short-lived upload token header returned by POST /emails/attachment-uploads, not a Sendmux API key.

parameters.name: X-Sendmux-Upload-Token
parameters.description: Short-lived upload token returned by POST /emails/attachment-uploads.

parameters.name: Content-Length
parameters.description: Exact number of bytes in the binary request body.

parameters.name: upload_id
parameters.description: Upload intent ID returned by POST /emails/attachment-uploads.

Location.description: Canonical URL for the temporary uploaded attachment metadata.

401.description: Upload token missing, invalid, or expired

404.description: Upload intent not found or expired

409.description: Upload already completed with different content

413.description: Uploaded bytes do not match the expected size

post.description: Queue a single email for delivery. Requires `email.send` permission.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key to make the request idempotent for 24 hours. Replays under the same key return the cached response; a reused key with a different body returns 409 idempotency_conflict.

400.description: Malformed request (invalid JSON or syntactic parameter error)

409.description: Idempotency conflict (Idempotency-Key reused with different body, or request already in flight)

422.description: Validation error (schema failures, accumulated in error.errors[])

429.description: Rate limit exceeded or Free daily sending limit reached (Retry-After header included)

post.description: Queue up to 100 emails for delivery in a single request. Uses partial success model — individual message failures do not fail the entire batch. Requires `email.send` permission.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key to make the request idempotent for 24 hours. Replays under the same key return the cached response; a reused key with a different body returns 409 idempotency_conflict.

200.description: Batch processed (check individual results for per-message status)

400.description: Malformed request (invalid JSON or syntactic parameter error)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded or Free daily sending limit reached (Retry-After header included)

503.description: Service unavailable or all messages failed with transient errors

get.description: Auto-generated OpenAPI 3.1 spec for the Sendmux Sending API. Public endpoint (no authentication). Emits a weak ETag; clients may send `If-None-Match` to receive 304 Not Modified.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Weak ETag from a previous response. When it matches the current resource, the server returns 304 Not Modified with no body.

ETag.description: Weak ETag of the canonical spec content

304.description: Spec has not changed (matches If-None-Match). Response body is empty per RFC 7232 §4.1.
